verdict.rationale: Codex cloud supports repository-specific environments configured with dependencies, tools, variables, and setup steps, and can start work from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack. Skills, plugins, and MCP servers can connect Codex to 'your team's tools and data' and to third-party documentation. None of the evidence describes a team-shared workspace built from docs and repos that serves as a common source of truth, so this is only glancing support. Missing for 10: an explicit shared team workspace feature, evidence that environments or configs are shared across team members, ingestion of docs and repos into a shared knowledge base, and independent corroboration.
